products.name: Pharmacy ERP
products.tagline: Medicines, batches, expiry and the counter.
products.description: For retail pharmacies, medical stores and pharmaceutical wholesalers: medicine catalogue, batch and expiry tracking, purchasing and receiving, dispensing and sales at the counter, and prescriptions. Finance & Accounting and Payroll can be added for the books and staff pay.

products.name: Retail & Trading ERP
products.tagline: Retail and wholesale trading, from the counter to the invoice.
products.description: For retail stores, supermarkets, wholesalers and trading companies: point of sale, quotations, orders, invoices, delivery notes, purchasing and stock. Finance & Accounting and Payroll can be added for the books and staff pay.

products.name: Restaurant ERP
products.tagline: Tables, orders and the kitchen, with bills and tills.
products.description: For restaurants, cafés, bars and hotel kitchens: the menu, table orders, kitchen tickets, bills and tills, and drinks stock. Finance & Accounting and Payroll can be added for the books and staff pay.

products.name: Education ERP
products.tagline: Admissions to results, with student fees.
products.description: For schools, colleges and universities: admissions, classes, attendance, examinations, student fees and staff. Finance & Accounting and Payroll can be added for the books and staff pay.

products.name: NGO Suite
products.tagline: Projects, grants, finance, procurement and results in one package.
products.description: For NGOs, implementing partners and donor-funded organizations: projects and programmes with partners and donors, grant agreements and disbursement requests, Finance & Accounting for the books, Procurement from requisition to supplier invoice, and Monitoring & Evaluation with field data collection for verified results. One subscription, one sign-in.

products.name: Monitoring & Evaluation
products.tagline: Results frameworks, indicators and verified results for donors.
products.description: For NGOs, humanitarian agencies, donors and government programmes: results frameworks, indicators with baselines and targets, results reported by site or partner with evidence, review and verification, donor reports built only from verified results, and data collection with forms and field teams. Its own application (ADR-0019); links to Project Management projects when the organization has both.

products.name: Procurement & Purchasing
products.tagline: From purchase request to delivery. All connected.
products.description: For any organization that buys: procurement plans, purchase requisitions with configurable approvals, suppliers, RFQs, proposals and tenders with evaluation and award approval, purchase orders with amendments, receiving and supplier invoice matching. Miles Procurement is its own application (ADR-0023); it works alone, and sends matched invoices to Finance & Accounting when the organization has it.

products.name: Finance & Accounting
products.tagline: Advanced accounting, on its own or with any Miles ERP.
products.description: Chart of accounts, journals, receivables, payables, banking and financial statements: the Finance application any Miles ERP can post to when it is added.

products.name: Payroll
products.tagline: Monthly payroll and payslips, with any Miles ERP or on its own.
products.description: Basic pay, allowances and deductions, income tax and social security, monthly payroll runs approved by a second person, and payslips. Takes staff from HR and hours from any Miles ERP, and posts one journal per payroll to Finance & Accounting.

products.name: Logbook
products.tagline: Structured operational records, reviewed and traceable.
products.description: Configurable log sheets for daily activity, generator, vehicle and maintenance logs: versioned templates, numbered entries, supervisor review, private attachments, reports with CSV and PDF exports, and a permanent audit trail. Miles Logbook is its own application (ADR-0025) and works on its own.
